description.value: DunnEnzies is a pizza-forward restaurant and event venue in Kelowna's Lower Mission neighbourhood, operating as one of three city locations under the DunnEnzies Pizza Co. brand. The Mission location is set around a back-yard style patio shaded by a 200-year-old London Plane tree, and doubles as a live-music and events stage hosting comedy, drag, trivia, and theatre. The menu spans creative specialty pizzas, tacos, and a full drinks list with daily specials.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and operating at 4638 Lakeshore Road (Mission/Lower Mission location), matching the OSM address. The website provides a phone number not present in OSM tags, and the menus confirm multiple vegetarian options (V-marked items) and online/phone ordering for takeout. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi was found on the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (236) 420-5722 sourced from website only.
OSM name is 'DunnEnzies'; full brand name on website is 'DunnEnzies Pizza Co.' — minor discrepancy, common name matches.
